newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Yeo Hiap Seng takes US$90 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Yeo Hiap Seng takes US$90 mln loan.

text.p: Yeo Hiap Seng said on Tuesday it had entered into a US$90 million term loan facility agreement with a group of banks and financial institutions.

It said in a statement the loan would be used to fund the development of a condominium project, purchase of equipment and provide working capital for expansion of the group's food and beverage activities in Singapore, China, Thailand and Indonesia.
The condominium project is being developed by wholly-owned subsidiary YHS Manufacturing Pte Ltd.
It said the loan facility was not expected to have a material effect on the net tangible assets and earnings per share of the company for the financial year ending December 31, 1997.
